extraction.Name: Louis Richard
extraction.Recorded patent: Patent recorded Aug. 7, 1922 by Home Abstract Co., Martin, So. Dak.
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged NW1/4 12-36-36 (with other land) to Rancheros State Bank, Cody, Nebr. for $1110.69 on June 1, 1926; mortgaged NW1/4 12-36-36 (with other land) to Rancher's State Bank, Cody, Nebr. for $2000.00 on Mar. 1, 1928; mortgaged NW1/4 12-36-36 to Federal Land Bank of Omaha, Nebr. for $1000.00 on August 31, 1922
extraction.NOTES: Receipt dated Jan. 15, 1920. On Oct. 13, 1928, Rancher's State Bank, Cody, Nebr. released mortgage on NW1/4 12-36-36 dated Mar. 1, 1928. Wife named Annie Richard. Mortgage of Aug. 31, 1922 to Federal Land Bank of Omaha recorded 10-12-1922. Information taken from records at the County Seat.
